items.title_en: Eli Lilly CEO pushes back on Dario Amodei's medical claims
items.title_zh: 礼来 CEO 反驳 Dario Amodei 的医疗主张
items.summary_en: The CEO of Eli Lilly pushed back against medical claims made by Dario Amodei. No further details about the claims or the response are available.
items.summary_zh: 礼来公司 CEO 反驳了 Dario Amodei 提出的医疗相关主张。现有信息未提供这些主张或回应的更多细节。

items.title_en: Doomsday: Friday, 13 November, A.D. 2026 (1960)
items.title_zh: 末日：2026 年 11 月 13 日，星期五（公元 1960 年）
items.summary_en: The item is titled “Doomsday: Friday, 13 November, A.D. 2026” and is dated 1960. No further details about its subject or contents are available.
items.summary_zh: 该条目标题为《末日：2026 年 11 月 13 日，星期五》，并标注为公元 1960 年。没有更多关于其主题或内容的可靠信息。

items.title_en: Elevated errors on claude.ai, Claude Code, and platform.claude.com
items.title_zh: claude.ai、Claude Code 和 platform.claude.com 错误率升高
items.summary_en: Claude’s status page reported elevated errors affecting claude.ai, Claude Code, and platform.claude.com. The notice identifies the affected services but provides no further incident details in the available information.
items.summary_zh: Claude 状态页报告称，claude.ai、Claude Code 和 platform.claude.com 的错误率升高。现有信息仅列出了受影响的服务，未提供更多事故细节。

items.title_en: Jensen Huang resigns
items.title_zh: 黄仁勋辞职
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang has resigned. The available material does not provide reliable details about the timing, reasons, or succession. The departure marks a leadership change at Nvidia.
items.summary_zh: 黄仁勋已辞职。现有材料没有提供有关时间、原因或继任安排的可靠细节。这意味着英伟达将发生领导层变动。

items.title_en: Why Zig over C for Systems Programming
items.title_zh: 为什么系统编程应选择 Zig 而不是 C
items.summary_en: The author compares Zig with C for systems programming, noting that both are small, garbage-collector-free languages designed to stay close to the machine. Rather than treating Zig as a wholly different alternative, the post examines parts of C that cost the author time and how Zig addresses them. The examples were compiled on a Mac using Zig 0.17 and Clang.
items.summary_zh: 作者比较了 Zig 和 C 在系统编程中的特点，指出两者都是小型、无垃圾回收器且贴近机器运行方式的语言。这篇文章并未把 Zig 视为完全不同的替代品，而是考察 C 中哪些部分会耗费时间，以及 Zig 如何应对这些问题。示例代码使用 Zig 0.17 和 Clang 在 Mac 上编译。

items.title_en: U.S. October PPI Rises 6.5% YoY, Highest in Nearly Four Years
items.title_zh: 美国 10 月生产者价格同比上涨 6.5%，近四年来最高
items.summary_en: U.S. producer prices rose 6.5% year over year in October, the highest increase since November 2022. The result was slightly below the 6.6% expectation but above September’s 6.3%, while prices rose 0.3% month over month versus the 0.4% forecast. September’s monthly increase was revised from 1.3% to 1.4%.
items.summary_zh: 美国生产者价格指数 10 月同比上涨 6.5%，创 2022 年 11 月以来最高涨幅。该结果略低于 6.6% 的预期，但高于 9 月的 6.3%；环比上涨 0.3%，也低于 0.4% 的预期。9 月环比涨幅则由 1.3% 修正为 1.4%。

items.title_en: Nvidia employees petition to bring back Jensen Huang
items.title_zh: 英伟达员工请愿要求让黄仁勋回归
items.summary_en: More than 1,600 comments, mostly supportive, have appeared on an internal Nvidia post urging the board to consider employee sentiment about former CEO Jensen Huang. The post was submitted before Huang’s resignation by a longtime engineer and asked the board to consider employee views before taking action. Some employees are now asking the board to find a way to bring Huang back despite reports of multiple extramarital affairs and his abrupt resignation.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达内部一则呼吁董事会考虑员工对前 CEO 黄仁勋看法的帖子已收到超过 1,600 条评论，其中大多数表示支持。该帖子由一名长期任职的工程师在黄仁勋辞职前提交，要求董事会在采取行动前考虑员工意见。尽管有报道称黄仁勋存在多段婚外情并突然辞职，仍有部分员工要求董事会设法让他回归。

items.title_en: The 42-Year Journey to Bring 'Neuromancer' to the Screen
items.title_zh: 《神经漫游者》登上荧幕的 42 年历程
items.summary_en: William Gibson published the seminal novel Neuromancer in 1984, and it has now made its way to Apple TV after a 42-year journey. The adaptation’s development is being examined through interviews, including one with actor Briana Middleton. The long path from novel to screen reflects the difficulty of bringing the work to a filmed production.
items.summary_zh: William Gibson 于 1984 年出版了经典小说《神经漫游者》，这部作品经过 42 年终于登上 Apple TV。相关制作过程通过包括演员 Briana Middleton 在内的采访得到介绍。从小说到影视作品的漫长历程，体现了将该作品搬上荧幕的复杂过程。

items.title_en: Claude Is Down
items.title_zh: Claude 宕机
items.summary_en: Claude’s incident and scheduled-maintenance history page is titled “Claude Is Down.” The available information provides no further details about the outage.
items.summary_zh: Claude 的事故与计划维护历史页面显示“Claude 宕机”。现有信息未提供此次中断的更多细节。

items.title_en: Microsoft Outlook/365 still down after 12 hours
items.title_zh: Microsoft Outlook/365 持续中断 12 小时后仍未恢复
items.summary_en: Microsoft said changes intended to improve serviceability were not producing the expected results during the Outlook/365 outage. The company was identifying alternative workstreams to increase capacity amid sustained traffic-management imbalances. The service had remained disrupted for more than 12 hours.
items.summary_zh: 微软表示，在 Outlook/365 宕机期间，为改善服务能力而实施的变更没有达到预期效果。面对持续的流量管理失衡，公司正在寻找其他工作方案以提升容量。服务中断当时已持续超过 12 个小时。

items.title_en: AI Is Destroying the Trust Between Writers and Readers
items.title_zh: 人工智能正在摧毁作家与读者之间的信任
items.summary_en: The item argues that AI is damaging trust between writers and readers. It focuses on the relationship between artificial intelligence and literary scams on Amazon.
items.summary_zh: 该条目认为，人工智能正在损害作家与读者之间的信任。内容聚焦于人工智能与亚马逊文学欺诈之间的关系。

items.title_en: Service degradation on Microsoft 365
items.title_zh: Microsoft 365 服务降级
items.summary_en: Microsoft 365 is experiencing service degradation. The available material does not specify which services are affected, the cause, or the expected resolution time. Users may therefore encounter disruptions while the incident is being addressed.
items.summary_zh: Microsoft 365 正在经历服务降级。现有材料没有说明受影响的具体服务、原因或预计恢复时间。因此，用户在问题处理期间可能会遇到服务中断。

items.title_en: A technical vision for the Haskell ecosystem
items.title_zh: Haskell 生态系统的技术愿景
items.summary_en: The Haskell Foundation’s technical leadership committee has been successfully established and is now fully operational. It has spent the past few weeks discussing its vision and strategy. The committee plans to develop initiatives and proposals requiring funding and execution, with participation from companies, contractors, volunteers, and the wider community.
items.summary_zh: Haskell Foundation 的技术领导委员会已经完成组建，目前正式运作。委员会过去几周一直在讨论愿景和战略。接下来，它计划推动需要资金和执行的项目与提案，并邀请企业、承包商、志愿者及更广泛的社区参与。

items.title_en: US university students tell surveillance cameras to Flock off
items.title_zh: 美国大学生让监控摄像头“滚蛋”
items.summary_en: Privacy concerns about Flock Safety’s automated license plate readers have sparked protests at schools across the United States. Stanford senior Angela Nguyen helped collect hundreds of signatures demanding that the university end its Flock contract and establish safeguards for similar tools. She argues that cameras recording where vehicles were at specific times could be exploited to target vulnerable people.
items.summary_zh: 对 Flock Safety 自动车牌识别摄像头的隐私担忧，已经在美国各地校园引发抗议。斯坦福大学大四学生 Angela Nguyen 帮助收集了数百个签名，要求学校终止与 Flock 的合同，并为未来使用类似技术制定保障措施。她认为，记录车辆在特定时间所在位置的摄像头可能被利用来针对弱势群体。

items.title_en: Global Microsoft Outage
items.title_zh: 微软全球宕机
items.summary_en: A major Microsoft outage left millions of people worldwide unable to access Outlook email, Teams meeting tools, and other common workplace services. The disruption affected multiple staples of modern office work.
items.summary_zh: 一次大规模微软服务宕机导致全球数百万人无法访问 Outlook 邮件、Teams 会议工具及其他常用办公服务。此次中断影响了现代办公中的多项基础服务。

items.title_en: EU Digital Identity Wallet rollout: every EU state on one board
items.title_zh: 欧盟数字身份钱包部署情况：27 个成员国一览
items.summary_en: A tracker lists the status, launch dates, and builders of EU Digital Identity Wallets across all 27 EU states. It was sourced and updated on October 15, 2026. The tracker cautions that national availability does not by itself establish EUDI certification.
items.summary_zh: 一份追踪表列出了欧盟 27 个成员国数字身份钱包的状态、上线日期和开发方，并于 2026 年 10 月 15 日完成资料更新。追踪表特别提醒，某国已提供钱包并不等同于获得 EUDI 认证。

items.title_en: IceWM
items.title_zh: IceWM
items.summary_en: IceWM is a fast, simple, and highly configurable window manager for the X Window System. It provides a taskbar, keyboard and mouse controls, dynamic menus, multiple-monitor support through RandR and Xinerama, themes, and optional session and wallpaper managers. Created by Marko Maček in 1997 using C++, it is now maintained on GitHub and is available on many Linux distributions and BSD systems.
items.summary_zh: IceWM 是面向 X Window System 的快速、简洁且高度可配置的窗口管理器。它提供任务栏、键盘和鼠标控制、动态菜单，以及通过 RandR 和 Xinerama 实现的多显示器支持，还支持主题和可选的会话、壁纸管理器。IceWM 由 Marko Maček 于 1997 年使用 C++ 创建，目前在 GitHub 上维护，并可用于多种 Linux 发行版和 BSD 系统。

items.title_en: Rust 1.100
items.title_zh: Rust 1.100
items.summary_en: The Rust team has released Rust 1.100.0. Rust is described as a language for building reliable and efficient software. Users with an existing rustup installation can install the new version through rustup.
items.summary_zh: Rust 团队发布了 Rust 1.100.0。Rust 被定位为用于构建可靠、高效软件的编程语言。已经通过 rustup 安装 Rust 的用户可以使用 rustup 获取新版本。

items.title_en: Anthropic IPO
items.title_zh: Anthropic 筹备首次公开募股
items.summary_en: Anthropic has filed to become a public company and published a founders’ letter along with related information. The company is organized as a public benefit corporation focused on securing AI’s benefits and mitigating its risks. It says AI could accelerate scientific innovation, increase economic growth, help cure major diseases, and address long-standing problems if managed well.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 已提交申请，准备成为一家上市公司，并公布了创始人公开信及相关信息。该公司采用公益公司架构，致力于发挥人工智能的益处并降低其风险。Anthropic 表示，如果得到妥善管理，人工智能可能加速科学创新、提高经济增长率、推动重大疾病治疗，并解决长期未能解决的问题。

items.title_en: Show HN: My $300 embroidery machine needed a subscription, so I built my own app
items.title_zh: Show HN：我的 300 美元刺绣机需要订阅，于是我自己写了应用
items.summary_en: A developer built a replacement app for a $300 embroidery machine that required a subscription. The project is published as Zigzag. The available description does not provide further technical details about the machine or the application.
items.summary_zh: 一名开发者为一台需要订阅的 300 美元刺绣机编写了替代应用。该项目以 Zigzag 的形式发布。现有描述没有提供有关机器或应用的更多技术细节。

items.title_en: The Dawn of the Data Intelligence Engineer
items.title_zh: 数据智能工程师的黎明
items.summary_en: AI has changed data-team work by allowing agents to handle much of the traditional workload. MotherDuck co-founder and data engineer Nick Ursa says he has no backlog for the first time in his career, yet remains busier because people must verify answers produced by LLMs and agents. The role is shifting from calculating correct numbers to ensuring that machine-generated numbers are correct.
items.summary_zh: AI 让代理能够承担许多传统数据团队工作，正在改变数据团队的工作方式。MotherDuck 联合创始人兼数据工程师 Nick Ursa 表示，这是他职业生涯中第一次没有待办积压，但他仍比过去更忙，因为人工仍需核验大语言模型和代理生成的答案。这个岗位正从计算正确数字，转向确保机器生成的数字正确。

items.title_en: US test reactor cleared for operations
items.title_zh: 美国测试反应堆获准运行
items.summary_en: The U.S. Department of Energy has cleared Oklo’s Groves Isotope Test Reactor in Texas for unrestricted operations. The reactor reached first criticality in August, less than a year after construction began, and is one of 11 projects selected for the DOE’s Nuclear Reactor Pilot Program. The approval allows Groves-1 to enter its research, testing, and training phase, with operating experience intended to inform Oklo’s planned Groves-2 Forge isotope facility.
items.summary_zh: 美国能源部已批准 Oklo 位于得克萨斯州的 Groves 同位素测试反应堆开展不受限制的运行。该反应堆在开工不到一年后的 8 月实现首次临界，是能源部核反应堆试点计划选中的 11 个项目之一。此次批准允许 Groves-1 进入研究、测试和培训阶段，其运行经验将用于指导 Oklo 计划中的 Groves-2 Forge 同位素设施。

items.title_en: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.summary_en: Google has introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen as a fast, cost-efficient model for agentic workflows and everyday tasks. The company positions it as a daily-use model for reliable agentic work. Google also says Hydrogen brings advanced intelligence to users broadly.
items.summary_zh: Google 推出了 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，将其定位为面向智能体工作流和日常任务的快速、高性价比模型。公司将其定位为可日常使用、适合可靠智能体工作的模型。Google 还表示，Hydrogen 将先进的智能能力带给更广泛的用户。

items.title_en: Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Orchestrator
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Hydrogen 与 Orchestrator
items.summary_en: Google Antigravity is rolling out Gemini 4 Hydrogen together with a new model-selector option called Orchestrator. Orchestrator pairs Hydrogen with Google’s strongest models for long-horizon tasks, including Gemini 4 Carbon. The combination is intended to balance quality, efficiency, and latency.
items.summary_zh: Google Antigravity 正在推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，以及模型选择器中的新选项 Orchestrator。Orchestrator 会将 Hydrogen 与包括 Gemini 4 Carbon 在内的 Google 最强模型搭配，用于长时程任务。该组合旨在平衡质量、效率和延迟。

items.title_en: Lonewolf 0.3 – A standalone XMPP server written in Rust
items.title_zh: Lonewolf 0.3：用 Rust 编写的独立 XMPP 服务器
items.summary_en: Lonewolf 0.3.0 adds certificate-authenticated federation, direct TLS, and additional desktop-client features. It remains a pre-1.0, single-node server, while full XMPP compliance and clustering are still on the roadmap. The release expands secure federation without yet providing those larger deployment features.
items.summary_zh: Lonewolf 0.3.0 新增基于证书认证的联邦通信、直接 TLS，以及更多桌面客户端功能。它仍是一个处于 1.0 之前阶段的单节点服务器，完整 XMPP 兼容性和集群支持仍在路线图中。此次更新增强了安全联邦能力，但尚未提供这些更大规模部署功能。

items.title_en: The Downfall of Jensen Huang: Nvidia's Greed and Corruption [video]
items.title_zh: 黄仁勋的陨落：英伟达的贪婪与腐败［视频］
items.summary_en: The video is titled “The Downfall of Jensen Huang: Nvidia’s Greed and Corruption.” No further details about its contents are available.
items.summary_zh: 该视频标题为《黄仁勋的陨落：英伟达的贪婪与腐败》。现有信息未提供视频内容的更多细节。

items.title_en: Palmfrets, Minnesota guitarist's invention, strikes a new chord
items.title_zh: 明尼苏达吉他手发明 Palmfrets，奏出新和弦
items.summary_en: Minnesota musician Ben Ranson has developed an invention called “palmfrets” that adds notes and possibilities to the guitar. He revealed the device during a performance at Stella’s restaurant in Fergus Falls on October 28. Ranson has reportedly worked on the invention for years.
items.summary_zh: 明尼苏达州音乐人 Ben Ranson 发明了名为“palmfrets”的装置，为吉他增加了更多音符和演奏可能性。他于 10 月 28 日在弗格斯福尔斯的 Stella’s 餐厅演出时展示了这项发明。据报道，Ranson 已经为此研究多年。

items.title_en: Brave Search API now accepts agentic payments via the x402 protocol
items.title_zh: Brave Search API 现可通过 x402 协议接受代理支付
items.summary_en: Brave Search API now lets developers and AI agents pay per query in USDC through the open x402 protocol, without an account or API key. Payments settle in real time, and Brave’s facilitator currently accepts USDC on the Base blockchain. The model supports on-demand web search and AI grounding through an agent wallet, while support for other networks and stablecoins is planned.
items.summary_zh: Brave Search API 现在允许开发者和 AI 代理通过开放的 x402 协议使用 USDC 按查询付费，无需账户或 API 密钥。支付会实时结算，目前 Brave 的支付协调器接受 Base 区块链上的 USDC。该模式支持代理通过钱包按需进行网页搜索和 AI grounding，其他网络和稳定币的支持则计划在后续推出。

items.title_en: Edge0-145B: Frontier AI Capabilities on Your Own Computer
items.title_zh: Edge0-145B：在自己的电脑上运行前沿 AI 能力
items.summary_en: Edge0 has open-sourced Edge0-145B and Edge0-120B, along with an inference framework and deployment tools. Edge0-145B is described as an open-source, on-device model with 145 billion parameters for coding, reasoning, and agent tasks. Local inference avoids cloud-model token fees, but large models still require substantial memory, bandwidth, and power.
items.summary_zh: Edge0 开源了 Edge0-145B 和 Edge0-120B，同时发布推理框架和部署工具。Edge0-145B 被称为首个开源的 1450 亿参数设备端模型，可用于编程、推理和智能体任务。本地推理无需支付云模型的 token 费用，但大型模型仍需要大量内存、带宽和电力。

items.title_en: Former Nvidia CEO Huang had a relationship with a second employee, sources say
items.title_zh: 消息人士称，英伟达前 CEO 黄仁勋曾与第二名员工有关系
items.summary_en: Sources say former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had a relationship with a second employee. No further details about the reported relationship are available.
items.summary_zh: 消息人士称，英伟达前 CEO 黄仁勋曾与第二名员工有关系。现有信息未提供这段关系的更多细节。

items.title_en: Jonathan Blow – If AI Solved Coding, Why Is My Software Still the Same? [video]
items.title_zh: Jonathan Blow：如果 AI 已解决编程，为什么我的软件还是老样子？［视频］
items.summary_en: The video is titled “If AI Solved Coding, Why Is My Software Still the Same?” by Jonathan Blow. No further details about the video’s contents are available.
items.summary_zh: 该视频由 Jonathan Blow 发布，标题为《如果 AI 已解决编程，为什么我的软件还是老样子？》。现有信息未提供视频内容的更多细节。

items.title_en: Dwarf planet candidate appears which takes roughly 280 years to orbit our sun
items.title_zh: 一颗矮行星候选体出现了，绕太阳一周约需 280 年
items.summary_en: Astronomers identified a distant object called ED138 in telescope images from the Vera C. Rubin Observatory. It appears unusually large and would take roughly 280 years to orbit the Sun. Its size still needs to be determined before astronomers can classify it as a dwarf planet.
items.summary_zh: 天文学家在维拉·鲁宾天文台的望远镜图像中发现了一个名为 ED138 的遥远天体。它看起来异常大，绕太阳一周大约需要 280 年。在将其归类为矮行星之前，天文学家仍需确定它的大小。

items.title_en: I'm making LLMs work on small and old devices
items.title_zh: 让大语言模型运行在小型和老旧设备上
items.summary_en: smolmaxxing explores how to run the largest practical language models on small or old devices such as TV boxes, phones, single-board computers, and routers. It uses custom kernels, memory optimization, and weight streaming, with claims measured on the actual hardware. On a Xiaomi TV Box S 3rd Gen with about 1 GB of usable RAM, the project reports running models ranging from 260K to 16B parameters.
items.summary_zh: smolmaxxing 探索如何在电视盒子、旧手机、单板计算机和路由器等小型或老旧设备上运行实际可用的最大语言模型。项目使用定制内核、内存优化和权重流式传输，并在真实硬件上测量各项结果。在可用内存约 1 GB 的 Xiaomi TV Box S 第三代上，项目报告称可运行参数量从 26 万到 160 亿不等的模型。

items.title_en: Foundation Models framework
items.title_zh: Foundation Models 框架
items.summary_en: Apple’s Foundation Models framework is a native Swift API for integrating large language models into apps. It provides access to Apple’s on-device foundation models and Private Cloud Compute. Built-in capabilities include guided generation, tool calling, image understanding, and Dynamic Profiles.
items.summary_zh: Apple 的 Foundation Models 框架是一个用于在应用中集成大语言模型的原生 Swift API。它支持访问 Apple 的设备端基础模型和 Private Cloud Compute。框架内置引导式生成、工具调用、图像理解和 Dynamic Profiles 等能力。

items.title_en: Switcher (2004)
items.title_zh: Switcher（2004）
items.summary_en: The author recalls Thunderscan, a low-cost, high-resolution scanner for the Macintosh developed with Thunderware after taking a leave of absence from Apple in March 1984. Work began in June 1984, and the product was nearly complete by early October. The account places the development in the author’s early post-Apple work.
items.summary_zh: 作者回忆了 Thunderscan：这是一款与 Thunderware 合作开发的低成本高分辨率 Macintosh 扫描仪，项目始于作者 1984 年 3 月离开 Apple 休假之后。开发于 1984 年 6 月开始，到 10 月初产品已基本完成。这段经历属于作者离开 Apple 后早期工作的内容。

items.title_en: Reverse Engineering My Coway Air Purifier to Ditch the Cloud
items.title_zh: 逆向工程我的 Coway 空气净化器，摆脱云端控制
items.summary_en: During the 2017 wave of annual wildfires on the West Coast, many Bay Area residents bought air purifiers because their homes were poorly insulated and sealed. The author describes buying a Coway Airmega to avoid breathing wildfire soot and reverse-engineering it to remove its dependence on cloud services. The project reflects a broader effort to keep household devices locally controlled.
items.summary_zh: 2017 年西海岸接连发生野火时，许多湾区居民因为房屋隔热和密封性能较差而购买空气净化器，以避免吸入野火烟尘。作者介绍了自己购买 Coway Airmega，并对其进行逆向工程，以摆脱对云端服务的依赖。这一项目体现了将家用设备控制权保留在本地的尝试。

items.title_en: Study Hard, Get a Career, Get Ahead? It's Not What It Used to Be
items.title_zh: 努力学习、找到职业、取得成功？这一切已不再像过去那样
items.summary_en: The item questions whether studying hard, building a career, and getting ahead still work as they once did. No further details about the arguments or evidence are available.
items.summary_zh: 该条目质疑努力学习、建立职业并取得成功是否仍像过去一样有效。现有信息未提供其论点或证据的更多细节。

items.title_en: Turning a 22-year-old Postgres type-confusion primitive into RCE
items.title_zh: 将 22 年前的 PostgreSQL 类型混淆原语转化为 RCE
items.summary_en: A researcher says they turned a 22-year-old type-confusion primitive in PostgreSQL core into remote code execution. The discovery emerged while investigating whether managed PostgreSQL was suitable for a project. The report characterizes the issue as a zero-day in PostgreSQL core.
items.summary_zh: 一名研究者称，他将 PostgreSQL 核心中一个存在 22 年的类型混淆原语转化为远程代码执行。这个发现源于对托管 PostgreSQL 是否适合某个项目的调查。报告将该问题描述为 PostgreSQL 核心中的零日漏洞。

items.title_en: Abandoned Quake 4 expansion finished by modders and now playable
items.title_zh: 被放弃的《Quake 4》扩展包由模组作者完成并已可游玩
items.summary_en: The never-released Quake 4 expansion is now playable through openQ4 0.14.1, the Awakening Edition. The free, open-source replacement engine includes a second campaign, stable shadow mapping, a rebuilt interface, Vulkan support on Windows, smarter bots, and an experimental Android app. It also supports the original campaign and multiplayer on current Windows, Linux, and Steam Deck systems.
items.summary_zh: 从未正式发行的《Quake 4》扩展包如今可通过 openQ4 0.14.1“觉醒版”游玩。这款免费开源的替代引擎加入了第二战役、稳定的阴影映射、重制界面、Windows Vulkan 支持、更智能的机器人以及实验性的 Android 应用。它还支持在当前的 Windows、Linux 和 Steam Deck 系统上运行原版战役和多人模式。

items.title_en: Show HN: Reflota – Open-source data recovery for NTFS/FAT disks with phased copy
items.title_zh: Show HN：Reflota——支持分阶段复制的 NTFS/FAT 开源数据恢复工具
items.summary_en: Reflota is a free, open-source, read-only tool for recovering files from NTFS, FAT32, FAT16, FAT12, and exFAT disks, including deleted files. It reads disks directly: for NTFS, it reconstructs the folder tree from the master file table and directory metadata, while for FAT and exFAT it reads directories and follows cluster chains. It is intended for cases where Windows reports that a disk is unformatted, a folder will not open, or Explorer hangs.
items.summary_zh: Reflota 是一款免费、开源且只读的数据恢复工具，支持从 NTFS、FAT32、FAT16、FAT12 和 exFAT 磁盘中恢复文件，包括已删除的文件。它会直接读取磁盘：处理 NTFS 时读取主文件表并根据目录元数据重建文件夹树，处理 FAT 和 exFAT 时读取目录并跟踪簇链。当 Windows 报告磁盘未格式化、文件夹无法打开或资源管理器卡死时，该工具可用于尝试恢复数据。

items.title_en: Talking Zen 6 with Mike Clark at AMD In-Depth
items.title_zh: 在 AMD 深度访谈中与 Mike Clark 谈 Zen 6
items.summary_en: The item is an interview with AMD’s Mike Clark about the Zen 6 architecture. The available text provides no further technical details.
items.summary_zh: 该内容是围绕 Zen 6 架构对 AMD Mike Clark 的访谈。现有文字未提供更多技术细节。

items.title_en: Our software engineering interviews are changing a little
items.title_zh: 我们的软件工程面试正在进行一些调整
items.summary_en: Jane Street says the widespread use of LLMs has changed how its engineers build software. Engineers now use these tools daily for writing, reading, debugging, and reviewing code, as well as for non-coding tasks. The company is therefore updating its software engineering interviews to reflect current development practices.
items.summary_zh: Jane Street 表示，LLM 的普及已经改变了工程师构建软件的方式。如今，其工程师每天都使用这类工具编写、阅读、调试和审查代码，也用于许多非编码任务。因此，公司正在调整软件工程面试，以反映当前的开发实践。

items.title_en: Why is Google cutting off Search from AI-free schools? Here are some theories
items.title_zh: Google 为什么要切断与“无 AI”学校的搜索服务？这里有几种猜测
items.summary_en: The item examines why Google may be cutting off Search from schools that avoid AI. It notes that Google is deeply embedded in the school day for millions of students, serving not only as a search engine but also as a hub for sharing documents and submitting homework. No specific explanation for the policy is provided in the available context.
items.summary_zh: 该条目探讨 Google 可能为何要切断对不使用 AI 的学校提供搜索服务。它指出，Google 已深度融入数百万学生的日常学习，不仅是搜索引擎，也是分享文档和提交作业的平台。现有信息未提供这一政策的具体原因。

items.title_en: Brazil's Caixa insurer breach exposes names and tax IDs of all 7.6M customers
items.title_zh: 巴西 Caixa 保险公司遭入侵，760 万客户的姓名和税号曝光
items.summary_en: A breach at Brazil’s Caixa insurer exposed the names and tax identification numbers of all 7.6 million customers. No further information about the incident is available.
items.summary_zh: 巴西 Caixa 保险公司遭遇数据泄露，全部 760 万名客户的姓名和税号被曝光。现有信息未提供更多关于此次事件的细节。

items.title_en: Show HN: AgentRun – open-source, Self-improving Managed Agents
items.title_zh: Show HN：AgentRun——开源、自我改进的托管智能体
items.summary_en: GREP.AI has open-sourced AgentRun as a managed platform for agents. It includes self-improving agents, web-grounded workflows, sandboxes, computer environments, tools and integrations, and behavioral analytics. AgentRun supports harnesses including Pi, Claude Agents, Codex, and OpenCode, and can be self-hosted or used as a hosted service.
items.summary_zh: GREP.AI 将 AgentRun 开源为一个托管智能体平台。它包含自我改进智能体、基于网页信息的工作流、沙箱和计算机环境、工具与集成，以及智能体行为分析。AgentRun 支持 Pi、Claude Agents、Codex 和 OpenCode 等 harness，也可自行托管或使用托管版本。

items.title_en: Libreagi – Save OSS Models
items.title_zh: LibreAGI：保存开源模型
items.summary_en: LibreAGI is a private BitTorrent tracker where members preserve copies of open models that may disappear from their original hosting locations. The project argues that open models should outlive the services that host them. It provides torrent-based tooling for sharing model copies.
items.summary_zh: LibreAGI 是一个私有 BitTorrent Tracker，成员可保存那些可能从原托管位置消失的开源模型副本。该项目认为，开源模型的存续时间不应受限于托管它们的服务。项目提供了基于种子文件共享模型副本的工具。

items.title_en: Researchers discover rare star system that emits radio signals every 8 minutes
items.title_zh: 研究人员发现每 8 分钟发出一次无线电信号的罕见星系系统
items.summary_en: Scientists at the Curtin University node of ICRAR linked mysterious radio pulses to a pair of stars known as GPM J071507−114153. The system contains a white dwarf and a G-type star similar to the Sun, orbiting each other. The white dwarf spins once every eight minutes, providing the unusual timing associated with the signals.
items.summary_zh: 国际射电天文学研究中心科廷大学节点的科学家将神秘无线电脉冲与名为 GPM J071507−114153 的双星系统联系起来。该系统由一颗白矮星和一颗类似太阳的 G 型恒星组成，两者相互绕行。白矮星每 8 分钟自转一周，这与信号出现的特殊周期相对应。

items.title_en: Relax: JIT compiler for Rust to reduce build times
items.title_zh: Relax：通过减少构建时间实现 Rust 的 JIT 编译器
items.summary_en: Relax is a live compiler and JIT runtime for Rust, itself written in Rust. It runs a Cargo package directly from source without rustc, LLVM, or a linker in the execution loop. Instead of building first and running afterward, Relax runs the program while it is being built.
items.summary_zh: Relax 是一个用 Rust 编写的 Rust 实时编译器和 JIT 运行时。它可以直接从源代码运行 Cargo 包，执行过程中不需要 rustc、LLVM 或链接器。与先构建、后运行不同，Relax 会在程序构建的同时运行它。

items.title_en: Show HN: Kapso – Iterative learning from enterprise data
items.title_zh: Show HN：Kapso——从企业数据中迭代学习
items.summary_en: Leeroo has open-sourced Kapso, an engine that runs experiments, deploys the best solution, and learns from each run. The project is designed for iterative work on large, messy enterprise data, where investigation and experimentation continually refine the result. One example involved migrating a company from a legacy data estate with more than 30 source-system families, thousands of tables and transformations, and hundreds of BI reports.
items.summary_zh: Leeroo 开源了 Kapso，这是一个能够运行实验、部署最佳方案并从每次运行中学习的引擎。该项目面向大型、复杂的企业数据，通过持续调查和实验不断改进结果。一个案例涉及将企业从旧数据系统迁移到湖仓架构，原系统包含 30 多类源系统、数千张表和转换，以及数百份 BI 报告。

items.title_en: Sift: LSP, Lint, Format Lisp, Scheme and Emacs Lisp
items.title_zh: Sift：用于 Lisp、Scheme 和 Emacs Lisp 的 LSP、Lint 与格式化工具
items.summary_en: Sift is an idempotent formatter, rule-based linter, and language server for Scheme, Emacs Lisp, and Common Lisp. It reports malformed Lisp source and rewrites whitespace while preserving comments and read-time forms in their original positions. Formatting an already formatted file produces no further changes, a property asserted across the test suite.
items.summary_zh: Sift 是面向 Scheme、Emacs Lisp 和 Common Lisp 的幂等格式化器、基于规则的 linter 和语言服务器。它会报告格式错误的 Lisp 源码并重写空白，同时保留注释和读取时形式的原始位置。对已经格式化的文件再次格式化不会产生变化，该特性在整个测试套件中都有断言验证。
